body: Here is what that means for your project — message by message.

chat.avatarAlt: Moritz Hecht, your direct contact at Invessiv

messages.title: One person
messages.body: You write with the person who builds your page. No handovers, no broken telephone.

messages.title: Clear scope
messages.body: The scope is fixed before the start — you know exactly what is included.

messages.title: No agency loop
messages.body: Your feedback goes straight into the build, not through three departments.

messages.title: Honest assessment
messages.body: If a landing page is not the right step for your offer, I will tell you.

messages.title: No hidden costs
messages.body: If something goes beyond the Starter, you decide up front — not the invoice.

messages.title: Honestly
messages.body: My first public reference project is currently in the works. Until it is live, I would rather convince you with a clear process than with logos.

chat.name: Moritz Hecht
chat.threadLabel: What to expect when you work with me

title: You work directly with me — not with an agency.
